system.boundary: Build a planar four-legged running robot in Simscape with a finite-mass torso, four articulated two-link legs, compliant knees, physical foot-ground contact, and finite electromechanical hip actuation.
engineering_objects: F90-XROBO-01 plant and controller described by the current public task contract
Measured output interfaces: body_state, contact_state, gait_state, electrical_state
physical_paths: A battery-backed electrical supply with an energy-buffering capacitor must feed the actual hip actuators, which transmit torque through mechanical joints to the legs.
functional_paths: Across the declared range, measured hip angle and angular speed must causally regulate the corresponding physical actuator during aerial motion, foot contact must govern the stance/aerial action, diagonal leg pairs must alternate support, and the torso must continue stable forward locomotion without bypassing the compliant legs or contact forces.
information_paths: initial_forward_speed_mps, supported_mass_kg, ground_stiffness_npm, ground_damping_nspm, propulsive_torque_nm, knee_stiffness_nmprad -> F90-XROBO-01 plant/control path -> body_state, contact_state, gait_state, electrical_state
modes_and_events: F90-XROBO-01 startup and continuous operation follow the current public task contract.
